# Meeting Mind

> Meeting Mind is a free AI meeting-notes app for Android and the web. It records and transcribes meetings, phone calls and in-person conversations, writes summaries and action items, and lets you ask questions about your recordings.

## What it does

- Record with your device microphone (in person, lectures, speakerphone) or upload existing audio
- Speech-to-text transcription with speaker identification and timestamps, language detected automatically (36+ languages)
- AI-generated summaries: key points, decisions, and action items
- Q&A over your own recordings, with citations
- Phone call recording and transcription (the other party hears a recording notice)
- Meeting bot for Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet: connect a Google or Outlook calendar (or paste a meeting link) and the bot joins as a visible participant named "Meeting Mind". The live transcript during a bot meeting is English only.

## Who it's for

People who attend recurring meetings, calls, or lectures and want an automatic record and summary instead of manual note-taking.

## Platforms

- Android (Android 10+): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kreativekoala.meetingmind
- Web app: https://meetingmind.org/auth

## Pricing

Meeting Mind is free. All features are included at no charge, subject to fair use and the per-file size and length limits in the terms (https://meetingmind.org/terms).

## Recording consent

You are responsible for telling people you record and for following the recording laws that apply to you.

Meeting Mind is made by KreativeKoalaSolutions LLC.
